title: Taras Bulba, and Other Tales
author: Nikolai Vasilevich Gogol
description: "Taras Bulba and Other Tales" by Nikolai Vasilevich Gogol is a collection of stories written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: The titular tale, "Taras Bulba," centers on the life and exploits of Taras, a fierce Cossack leader, and his two sons who have returned from their education.

authorInfo.bio: Nikolai Vasilevich Gogol (1809–1852) wrote Taras Bulba, and Other Tales. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
